subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 01, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - November 1, 2026**

**Breaking News:**

A massive pile of security updates for Saturday has been issued by AlmaLinux, affecting various packages including .NET, aspell, bind, and curl. These updates are now available for installation in AcreetionOS, ensuring the security and stability of our community-driven Linux distribution.

**Community News:**

The AcreetionOS community has been actively contributing to the project, with several developers working on various aspects of the distribution. The community's efforts have led to the resolution of a geocode-glib update conflict, as well as the implementation of a fix for a displaymanager job crash in the Calamares installer.

**Practical Tip:**

To ensure you're running the latest security updates, make sure to regularly check for updates in the AcreetionOS package manager. You can do this by running the following command in the terminal:

`sudo pacman -Syu`

This will update all installed packages to the latest versions, including the security updates mentioned above.

Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in the AcreetionOS community by following us on social media or joining our Discord server.
